name: AI data project contributor (CrowdGen by Appen)
summary: Appen's contributor platform where you apply to individual AI data projects, some of them reserved for Canada residents.
whatYouDo: You apply to a specific project and CrowdGen creates your account and onboards you. Canada-only projects have included rating AI-generated text and recording short video reactions (Project Coffee), facial-image annotation (Project Pine) and Canadian French evaluation (Project Babel).
appeal: Official project pages reserved for Canada residents, including Canadian French work
Pay rate shown on each project page before you apply (e.g. US$16.50/hr, about C$23, on Project Coffee)
Project Coffee: work any time of day as long as weekly targets are met
Large, long-running company; says it never charges contributors to join
watchOuts: The Canada project pages found are 1–2 years old and may be closed
Pay varies by country and language; reviews report some projects paying far below minimum wage
Some projects need an assessment or language exam
Some projects involve recording yourself or face images – a privacy consideration

training.notes: Project-specific onboarding instructions are emailed after you apply.

compensation.notes: Project Coffee (Canada) page: US$16.50/hr (~C$23), up to 20 hrs/week; page about a year old. A Project Babel (Canadian French) page advertises $22/hr (currency not shown in summary). Paid in local currency via bank transfer or PayPal.

reliability.notes: Project-based; 2026 reviews describe inconsistent availability. Indeed Canada employee reviews (Aug 2025) rate pay/benefits 2.8/5 (employees, not contributors).

applicationSteps: Find a CrowdGen project page open to Canada residents
Apply to that project; CrowdGen emails account-creation instructions
Complete any project assessment or language exam
Set up payment in the dashboard's Payments tab
fitsIf: You live in Canada (bonus if bilingual) and are happy to apply project by project for occasional paid tasks.
notFitIf: You want a single ongoing role or are uncomfortable sharing video or face images.

sources.title: How do I start working at CrowdGen?
sources.notes: New contributors apply to a project and receive emailed account instructions; payment set up afterwards.

sources.title: Project Coffee
sources.notes: Canada residents, fluent English, up to 20 hrs/week, computer with microphone; US$16.50/hr (~C$23); text evaluation and short video reactions. Page reportedly ~1 year old.

sources.title: Project Babel: Help AI speak Canadian French better (C)
sources.notes: Canada residents with strong English and French writing. A related Babel page advertises $22/hr for evaluators.

sources.title: Project Pine
sources.notes: Facial recognition annotation; Canada residents, native English, arts/photography/design background.

sources.title: Appen (CrowdGen) Review (2026): AI Training Jobs, Pay, Tasks & Reality
sources.notes: Review: pay priced by country/language; inconsistent project availability. Affiliate-style blog.

sources.title: Crowdgen Bewertungen
sources.notes: User reviews; one (China-based work, not Canada) reports not being paid what was owed after the platform change. Anecdotal.

sources.title: Appen Employee Reviews
sources.notes: Employee reviews (last updated Aug 2025) rate pay and benefits 2.8/5; employees, not contributors.
